# Van Acht neemt nieuw distributiecentrum in gebruik met 54.000 palletplaatsen, automatisering volgt

Peter de Weerd

3 september 2026

 

Van Acht Logistics heeft zijn nieuwe warehouse in Veghel in gebruik genomen. De uitbreiding krijgt uiteindelijk 28.000 volautomatische palletplaatsen en 26.000 palletplaatsen die met smallegangentrucks worden bediend. Tegelijkertijd investeert het familiebedrijf fors in energieopslag om de automatisering en verdere elektrificatie van de logistiek mogelijk te maken.

De bouw van het nieuwe distributiecentrum ging in november 2025 van start. Begin februari 2026 werd het eerste stalen spant geplaatst en inmiddels zijn de eerste pallets in het warehouse opgeslagen. Voor het nieuwe gebouw behaalde Van Acht het BREEAM-NL Outstanding ontwerpcertificaat.

## 28.000 palletplaatsen volledig geautomatiseerd

Na de bouwkundige oplevering verschuift de aandacht naar de inrichting. Van Acht start met de realisatie van een geavanceerd automatiseringssysteem met 28.000 volautomatische palletplaatsen voor klant Mars. De logistieke dienstverlener

Spartan Logistics Expands Toledo Presence Through Strategic Acquisition

 Spartan Logistics 

Sep 09, 2026, 11:40 ET

WHITEHOUSE, Ohio, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Spartan Logistics, a family-owned third-party logistics provider specializing in warehousing and transportation services, today announces the acquisition of Allen Logistics, a warehousing company supporting customers in Whitehouse, Ohio. The acquisition became effective September 1, 2026.

The acquisition adds 100,000 SF of warehousing capacity to Spartan's existing Toledo operations as the seventh warehouse operation in Northwest Ohio, a market that has been an important part of Spartan's network and long-term growth strategy. This brings the company to 4.5 million SF of total space and 950,000 SF in Northwest Ohio.

Spartan is focused on providing a seamless transition for existing customers and providing resources, technology, and efficiencies to the facility, while also identifying opportunities to bring additional business to the operation.

results.author: Andrew Larson

Uline offers up to $34 an hour, $5K bonuses at Plainfield warehouse

# Uline offers up to $34 an hour, $5K bonuses at Plainfield warehouse

Uline's new distribution center in Plainfield. Contributed Photo

By Andrew Larson

September 9, 2026

Uline will hold a hiring event Saturday as it prepares to open its new 1.2 million-square-foot Plainfield distribution center in November.

The family-owned distributor of shipping, packaging and industrial supplies is recruiting warehouse associates for day and night shifts at the facility.

The hiring event will take place from 8 a.m. to noon Saturday, Sept. 12, at 113 Plainfield Pike.

The positions will pay between $26 and $34 an hour, depending on the shift and experience. New hires are also eligible for a $5,000 bonus, according to the company’s job posting.

Benefits include health insurance and a 401(k) with a 6% employer match starting on the first day of employment, along with paid time off and tuition assistance for continuing education. The facility will have an on-site fitness center.

Day shift associates work Monday through Friday from 10:30 a.m. to 7 p.m., and night shift associates work Sunday through Thursday from 9 p.m. to 5

# Camco Chemical Announces 130,000-Square-Foot Northern Kentucky Distribution Expansion

 Published on Wednesday, September 2, 2026 by Nicole Shakir, Managing Editor of Expansion Solutions Magazine 

### New Independence facility will expand fulfillment, warehousing and supply chain capacity for the family-owned manufacturer

INDEPENDENCE, Ky. (September 2, 2026) — RSA Properties LLC and Camco Chemical have announced plans to construct a new 130,000-square-foot warehouse and distribution center on Camco Chemical’s existing Holton Drive campus in Independence, Kentucky.

The new facility will expand Camco’s fulfillment and distribution capacity while strengthening its broader supply chain capabilities and supporting continued growth across its contract manufacturing operations in Northern Kentucky.

RSA Properties, the family-owned real estate entity developing the project, will work with Furlong Building as contractor. Once complete, Camco Chemical will integrate the facility into its existing operations.

# Governor Moore Announces New Saval Foods Headquarters and Distribution Center in Howard County 

 Press Release | September 9, 2026 

 Updated: September 9, 2026 

ANNAPOLIS, MD — Governor Wes Moore today announced that family-owned foodservice distribution company Saval Foods, in partnership with Howard Hughes Communities, has broken ground on a new headquarters facility. The company is constructing a 230,000 square-foot space in Columbia to include a new distribution center and multi-story office building. Saval Foods will retain its existing 391 full-time employees and create an additional 107 new full-time jobs in the state over the next four years.
